bio: Antonino Colosimo, also recorded as Antonio, lived at San Mango di Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy, where he was buried on 7 January 1673. He was almost certainly the husband of Angila Vaccaro and the father of Antonio Colosimo, who was baptized on 15 June 1659. He is John's 9th-great-grandfather.
